claim: The latest rebuttal overstates three points: summandwise divergence, exclusivity of the five-moment cancellation route, and the status of force_smooth as an unlinked generic assumption.
established: The manuscript requires the total residual and all derivatives to extend smoothly even when individual residual terms can diverge.
The manuscript presents multiple correction operations; the five radial equations are one load-bearing operation in the stated cycle.
The selected Lean path derives force_smooth from concrete physical-data estimates, vanishing joint jets, residual recurrence, locally uniform limits, and smooth extension.
The exported Witness still lacks a final selected-field identification theorem for the manuscript's (M,I,J,S,Cp) observables and their transport through the full construction.
not_established: That every summand of the residual diverges as t approaches 1.
That the five moments are the sole cancellation mechanism in the manuscript.
That the selected force is nonsmooth or that literal connected C or D is false.
That the complete manuscript mechanism has been transported to the selected endpoint.
